name: Rama
source:
He and his wife Sarah are supposed to be in Macau on their honeymoon, but they are actually investigators from the KPK (Indonesian Commission for the Eradication of Corruption).
He  came to Macau to investigate the laundering of corrupt money by Indonesian police officials through the Raksasa party.
He is an expert Silat practitioner and speaks a little Cantonese.
He met Yvet by chance and helped her in her confrontation with the Raksasa party.
translation:
He and his wife Sarah are supposed to be in Macau on their honeymoon, but they are actually investigators from the KPK (Indonesian Commission for the Eradication of Corruption).
He  came to Macau to investigate the laundering of corrupt money by Indonesian police officials through the Raksasa party.
He is an expert Silat practitioner and speaks a little Cantonese.
He met Yvet by chance and helped her in her confrontation with the Raksasa party.
